description: This package contains Microsoft Azure SDK for Service Groups Management SDK. For documentation on how to use this package, please see https://aka.ms/azsdk/java/mgmt. The Groups RP provides Service Groups as a construct to group multiple resources, resource groups, subscriptions and other service groups into an organizational hierarchy and centrally manage access control, policies, alerting and reporting for those resources. Package api-version 2024-02-01-preview.
